description:
Introducing the all-new Endeavor Titanium Gravel Bike from Airborne. Named for the spirit of bold exploration and discovery, the Endeavor represents the pinnacle of Airborne’s aviation heritage and our dedication to titanium engineering and manufacturing excellence. Designed to go anywhere and do anything, this premium titanium machine delivers refined performance and unmatched versatility across pavement, gravel roads, technical trails, and remote off-road adventures.

Equipped with the innovative RideDNA™ headset system with up to 13 position adjustable head tube angle, it is designed for riders who demand a bike that can be precisely tuned to their riding style and the terrain ahead — without ever compromising the classic Airborne titanium character.

Key features:

RideDNA™ Dynamic Customization™ hardware; 13 position adjustable headset system — modify head tube angle for optimized stability, agility, or all-terrain confidence. Adjust to match your preferred trail preference or normalize your geometry for a longer suspension fork.

Advanced hydroformed titanium T/T and D/T — precisely engineered shapes for superior stiffness where you need it, compliance where you want it, and a strikingly modern, aggressive aesthetic.

SLM 3D Printed Grade 5 (6Al/4V) Titanium, Vacuum Annealed frame components: UDH Dropouts, Headtube, Dual Dropped Chainstay Yoke

Generous tire clearance — of up to 54mm, ready for fast-rolling gravel tires or high-volume adventure setups

Adventure-ready frame mounts — 4 sets of adjustable W/B or Bag mounts, perfectly equipped for bikepacking, racks, fenders, and long-distance exploration.

Dropper post compatible 31.6mm native seat post diameter or convert to a 27.2mm compliant Ti or Carbon post with the included seat post shim adapter.

Modern gravel geometry — Packaged in a classic double diamond frame design; balanced, confidence-inspiring handling with efficient power transfer.

For riders seeking the refined character of Airborne titanium with the game-changing versatility of the RideDNA system and adjustable head tube angle, the Endeavor offers a purposeful, forward-looking evolution in gravel bike design.
